Excel.open_excel.title: Open Excel
Excel.open_excel.comment: Open the Excel file at @{file_path} and return the Excel object @{open_excel_obj}

default_application.title: Default Application
default_application.tip: Select the default application. Available options: Excel or WPS

Excel.get_excel.title: Get Open Excel Object
Excel.get_excel.comment: Get the Excel object with file name @{file_name} and return the Excel object @{get_excel_obj}

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.tip: Enter the file name. No need to enter the previously opened Excel variable

Excel.create_excel.title: Create Excel
Excel.create_excel.comment: Create an Excel file named @{file_name} at @{file_path} and return the Excel object @{create_excel_obj}

default_application.title: Default Creation Application
default_application.tip: Select the default application used to create the file. Available options: Excel or WPS

exist_handle_type.title: File Exists Handling
exist_handle_type.tip: Select how to handle an existing file. Available options: overwrite, rename, or cancel save

Excel.save_excel.title: Save Excel
Excel.save_excel.comment: Save Excel object @{excel} using save mode @{save_type}

save_type.title: Save Type
save_type.tip: Select the save type. Available options: save or save as

exist_handle_type.title: File Exists Handling
exist_handle_type.tip: Select how to handle an existing file. Available options: overwrite, rename, or cancel save

close_flag.title: Close File
close_flag.tip: Select whether to close the file after saving. Available options: close or do not close

Excel.close_excel.title: Close Excel
Excel.close_excel.comment: Close @{close_range_flag}, current Excel object @{excel}, with save mode @{save_type_one||save_type_all}

close_range_flag.title: Close Document Range
close_range_flag.tip: Select the range of documents to close, such as the current document or all documents

save_type_one.title: Save Type
save_type_one.tip: Select the save type. Available options: save, save as, or do not save

save_type_all.title: Save Type

exist_handle_type.title: File Exists Handling

pkill_flag.title: Terminate Process
pkill_flag.tip: Select whether to terminate the process. Available options: terminate or do not terminate

Excel.edit_excel.title: Write to Excel
Excel.edit_excel.comment: Edit Excel object @{excel} and write content @{value}

edit_range.title: Edit Range
edit_range.tip: Select the edit range. Available options: row, column, or area

sheet_name.title: Worksheet Name
sheet_name.tip: Enter the worksheet name to edit, such as 'Sheet1'. If empty, the first worksheet object in the Excel file is used by default

start_col.title: Start Column
start_col.tip: Enter the starting column to edit. Both letter format (such as 'A') and number format (such as 1) are supported

start_row.title: Start Row
start_row.tip: Enter the starting row number to edit, counting from 1. This can be left empty when COLUMN is selected, but is required when ROW or AREA is selected

value.title: Content to Write
value.tip: Enter the content to modify as a list. When row or column is selected, enter a list such as [1,2,3], meaning 1,2,3 are written in order to the specified row or column. When area is selected, enter a list such as [[1,1],[2,2]], meaning data is written row by row into the specified area

edit_type.title: Write Mode
edit_type.tip: Select the write type. Available options: overwrite or append

insert_content.title: Inserted Content
insert_content.tip: When inserting one or more rows, the inserted content must be a multidimensional list, and strings must use single quotes ''. Example: insert 1 row with content [[123,24,32]]; insert 2 rows with content [[123,123],['aaa']], then the actual written Excel content will be: first row: 123 123; second row: aaa. If the content is [[123,123],'aaa'], then the actual written Excel content will be: first row: 123 123; second row: a a a. If the inserted rows or columns exceed the data length, the extra cells remain empty
